name: An'she's Radiance
summary: A vision calls for An'she's Radiance to be brought from Maraudon to Mulgore. The crystal is held in a chamber guarded by giants.

sections.title: A Vision in Mulgore
sections.body: A vision sends you toward Maraudon for An'she's Radiance. The crystal rests high in a chamber filled with bright white crystals, beyond the earth song falls. Mighty giants guard that place. You are asked to carry the crystal beneath Mulgore's open skies.

faq.answer: An'she's Radiance is a brilliant crystal described as an aspect of An'she, the sun god and the Earthmother's right eye.
An'she's Radiance is in a chamber deep within Maraudon, high among brilliant white crystals.
Mighty giants guard the chamber where An'she's Radiance rests.
A vision calls for An'she's Radiance to be brought from Maraudon to Mulgore, beneath the open skies.
